entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What took you so long!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Why're you all pissy?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Sorry... I had a run-in with some woman[n]a second ago.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: She bumped into me, but then said it was[n]all my fault when she dropped her plate...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Sounds like a real bitch...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah... Thanks though.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But... the restaurant workers all looked[n]at me with this disapproving expression...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I wonder if we're out of place here...
We're not.
Maybe.
It always feels like this.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, Morgana.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What is it?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Anyone could have a Palace, yeah?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Anyone with a strong, distorted desire.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Same for them havin' a change of heart[n]if their Treasure gets stolen?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That would be the case.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Why are you bringing this up all of a[n]sudden?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We had trouble earlier too. These selfish[n]shitheads who just looked down on[n]everyone else...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...I was just wonderin' if we'd be able to[n]change those kindsa people too.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You mean... you wanna continue as the[n]Phantom Thieves?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...I've been thinkin'.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We put a lot of work into changin'[n]Kamoshida's heart, but nobody[n]believes in the Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Plus... those guys who had no other[n]choice but to just deal with it are[n]thankin' us. Us, of all people.
What do you think, Ann?
It's pretty unexpected.
There are lots of victims.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I... I agree.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: If we ignore people who are in trouble,[n]I'd go back to being the same as I was[n]before...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well... that's true.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You're under my tutelage. There's[n]nothing we can't accomplish as[n]phantom thieves!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Shouldn't we be able to help 'em out?
I didn't even think of such a possibility...
But it's true that with this power, we may[n]be able to help people...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That means we'll have to fight Shadows[n]again, doesn't it...?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Indeed. That can't be avoided.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Eh, I'm sure we'll manage.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hehehe... Right?
Fine by me.
I want to help people.
If you're up for it.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Heh... Even if you guys are still just[n]fledglings, this means we're an actual[n]organization now.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Fledglings? Haha, that's actually pretty[n]fitting for us.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All right, it's settled!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We're gonna catch all these shitty adults[n]by surprise, and make ourselves known to[n]the world!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...Are you okay being our leader?
Of course.
Why?
That sounds tough.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: No objections here! I can't handle all that[n]responsibility stuff.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Where's my say in this? But Lady Ann[n]made the recommendation, so I'll allow it.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well, should we decide on a name for[n]our group?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I just went with Phantom Thieves of[n]Hearts last time, but don't you think[n]a real name would be cooler?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Ooh, I've got it! I want it to be something[n]both cute and luxurious sounding...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Let me see...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: How about "The Diamonds"?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...I'm gettin' a real little league baseball[n]feel from it.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well then, here's my suggestion.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: How about "Tilefish Poele"?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Tile... uh, what?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's what I ate earlier.[n]It's commemorative, no?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hell no, you idiot!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ugh, you decide for us...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh, that's not bad at all.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: A good name, for a rookie.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, did you like mine?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, Lady Ann came up with the idea,[n]so I have no objections.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Are these guys for real?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm the one who said that first![n]Gimme some credit!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For real...?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I feel like that name's going to make me[n]hungry every time I say it...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: [group].[n]We goin' with that?
If that's okay.
Maybe not.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well now that the name's set, who's our[n]next target?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: There are tons of rotten adults and all...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Why not just stick to targeting big[n]names?
Like a celebrity?
Like a CEO?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah, something along those lines. If we[n]go after some bigwig, it's gotta get on the[n]news, right?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Don't you think more people would[n]believe in us if we did that?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's not a bad idea... for you, Ryuji.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: True. If we become better known... we[n]might be able to give courage to a lot[n]more people.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I don't really like the idea of just picking[n]someone out of the blue though.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Let's narrow it down to someone we can[n]all agree on then.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hm, so we need a bigwig we decide on[n]unanimously.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I like that unanimous decision part![n]It's like we're making some kind of pact!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Now then, this is the official formation of[n]the Phantom Thieves organization!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh no! Our time for the buffet ran out...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I guess we'll just have to talk more[n]tomorrow.
